Upon reviewing the solutions, Solution 1 is correct. The polygon must have 7 sides, as shown by the calculations leading to the conclusion that n = 7 is the only value that fits the constraints provided by the problem. Solutions 2 and 3 contain mathematical errors. Solution 2 incorrectly calculates n using the equation derived from an incorrect assumption, and Solution 3 incorrectly dismisses potential values of n without properly evaluating them against the condition that all interior angles must be less than $180^{\circ}$. 

CHOICE: 1
